sources.shortCitation: Deutsches Lied, entry for “Wenn wir nicht beide in Gesellschaft wären” (1000 Takte-Tanz, Band 2)
sources.fullCitation: “Wenn wir nicht beide in Gesellschaft wären, würde ich dir Liebe schwören (Vergißmeinnicht)”, melody by Bronislaw Kaper, words by Fritz Rotter, 1929. Indexed from 1000 Takte-Tanz, Band 2: 22 der populärsten Tanz- und Gesangs-Schlager, shelfmark A1184-2, page 12, with text, melody and piano setting. Deutsches Lied, index of German song collections, record 2197024.
sources.title: Deutsches Lied — record 2197024
sources.creator: Deutsches Lied
sources.researchNote: The index gives the melody to Kaper alone. Neither it nor the Jurmann work catalogue records a share for Walter Jurmann, whose credit was carried here without an item-level source and has been withdrawn; that catalogue does not list the song at all, and no longer stands among the sources for it.
